cards.stem: Which element was included among the three parts of the Lee Resolution?
cards.quote: The Lee Resolution contained three parts: a declaration of independence, a call to form foreign alliances, and "a plan for confederation."
cards.hint: Recall what the resolution proposed to organize for the future.

cards.stem: What group did Congress establish on June 11, 1776 to work on the Lee Resolution?
cards.quote: On June 11, 1776, the Congress appointed three concurrent committees in response to the Lee Resolution
cards.hint: Think about how Congress divided the work after the proposal.

cards.stem: How many colonies cast affirmative votes for the Lee Resolution as listed on the document?
cards.quote: the affirmative votes of 12 colonies are listed at the right
cards.hint: Look at the tally shown on the right side of the document.

cards.stem: What did New York do regarding the Lee Resolution vote before July 9, 1776?
cards.quote: New York cast no vote until the newly elected New York Convention upheld the Declaration of Independence on July 9, 1776.
cards.hint: Consider which colony waited for new instructions before backing independence.
